name: Pure Veg Multi-Cuisine Restaurant
summary: Idli, dosa & South Indian meals — plus North Indian and Chinese on the menu.
description: Our ground-floor restaurant serves fresh South Indian breakfast from 7:00 AM, unlimited meals at lunch, and à la carte dinner. Pure vegetarian kitchen. Room service available till 11:00 PM.

name: Filter Coffee Corner
summary: Complimentary hot filter coffee, morning and evening.
description: Freshly brewed degree coffee served in the traditional davara-tumbler, complimentary for all in-house guests. Tea, badam milk and buttermilk also available through the day.

name: Ayurveda Massage Centre
summary: Traditional Kerala-style oil massage, available on request.
description: Trained therapists offer traditional abhyanga oil massage and head massage. Advance booking recommended — please inform the front desk at least 2 hours ahead.

name: Free Parking
summary: Free covered parking for cars and two-wheelers.
description: Covered parking available on-site at no extra charge, with 24-hour security. Please collect a parking token from the front desk on arrival.

name: 24-Hour Front Desk
summary: Someone at the desk round the clock, for anything you need.
description: Our front desk runs 24 hours for check-in, luggage storage, taxi bookings, railway station pickup and local sightseeing help. Just call extension 9 from your room.

name: Laundry & Ironing
summary: Same-day laundry if given before 9 AM.
description: Washing and ironing service charged per piece. Clothes given before 9:00 AM are returned the same evening. Express service available at 1.5x charge.
